frames.rest: patient model space, Blender metres, Z up, faces -Y, patient left = +X (all markers/sockets bone-parented to mixamorig:Spine; Hips/Spine/Spine1/Spine2 are rigid together in TABLE_REST)
frames.socket_local: organ frame: +X patient left, +Y head / organ long axis, +Z anterior (organ front). Organ meshes are authored in it: an organ placed at its socket with identity local transform sits in the body.
frames.incision_marker_local: INC_*: +Z skin normal = pull direction, +Y long axis toward the head, +X patient left (v02 convention)
frames.unity_local: after FBX import every marker/socket-local frame has X negated (Unity +X = patient RIGHT); *_unity values already have x negated and rotations mirrored (xyzw)
frames.table_blender: TABLE-ASTRA-001 v02 table-local Blender in the TABLE_REST pose (head end -Y, patient left -X)
frames.table_unity: OperatingTableAstra_v02 prefab-local Unity = (-x, z, -y) of table_blender

size_rule.note: widths/depths x0.9 of a real adult; Buddy's trunk is short (x0.67 in height), so the lungs are ~15.5 cm tall instead of 25*0.9; every organ is 1:1 world scale, scale (1,1,1) - the same size in the body, in the hand and on the tray

ORGAN_HEART.pivot: organ centre = socket origin (mesh authored in socket space)

ORGAN_LUNG_L.pivot: organ centre = socket origin (mesh authored in socket space)
ORGAN_LUNG_L.source: LUNGS-ASTRA-001_recolour_v01: Lungs_Lobe_R + Lungs_BranchFront_R + Lungs_BranchRear_R (the model names its pair from the viewer; its +X lobe is the patient-left lung)

ORGAN_LUNG_R.pivot: organ centre = socket origin (mesh authored in socket space)

ORGAN_LIVER.pivot: organ centre = socket origin (mesh authored in socket space)

ORGAN_KIDNEY_L.pivot: organ centre = socket origin (mesh authored in socket space)
ORGAN_KIDNEY_L.source: KIDNEY-ASTRA-001_recolour_v01 (mesh 'R_Kidney and descending tube' = patient-left kidney)

ORGAN_KIDNEY_R.pivot: organ centre = socket origin (mesh authored in socket space)

ribcage_notes.hierarchy: SOCKET_THORAX > RIBCAGE > RIBCAGE_HALF_L|R (hinge pivot) > RIB_<L|R>_01..09, STERNUM_<L|R>; SPINE_THORACIC under RIBCAGE
ribcage_notes.rib_pivot: each rib's origin = its vertebral head (costovertebral joint); axes = SOCKET_THORAX axes
ribcage_notes.sternotomy: the sternum is split on the midline into STERNUM_L / STERNUM_R (mallet + osteotome cut line = GUIDE_CHEST_START -> GUIDE_CHEST_END on the skin); the halves' midline faces use MAT_Bone_Cut_v03
ribcage_notes.open: rotate RIBCAGE_HALF_L about its local +Y by +35 deg and RIBCAGE_HALF_R by -35 deg (Blender); in Unity (mirrored X) the signs flip: L -angle, R +angle about local Y
ribcage_notes.ribs_1_7: true ribs (bone + costal cartilage to the sternum)
ribcage_notes.ribs_8_9: false ribs (cartilage joins the rib above = costal arch)

heart_vessel_stubs_note: ORGAN_HEART carries short cut stubs (aorta, pulmonary trunk, SVC, IVC, 4 pulmonary veins) with a dark lumen; each VESSELS_* tube starts 4 mm inside its stub. To 'cut' the heart free hide/shorten the VESSELS_* near their snip points; the stubs stay on the removed heart.

opening_abdomen.shape: asymmetric lens: |x| = W (1 - |t|^p)^q, t = y / half_length (top or bottom)

chest.note: future sternotomy: no chest opening mesh yet. The head capsule's chin overlaps the upper chest skin; see the TABLE_REST review render for how much of the chest the operation camera sees.

unity_integration: 1. Patient: point the patient prefab at SAUSAGE_BUDDY_PATIENT_v03.fbx (same 65-bone rig, avatar and clips as v02). The Body has THREE material slots now: [0] Buddy_Skin (front torso zone only), [1] Buddy_Skin_Nose, [2] Patient_Skin_Closed. Give slot 2 a copy of the skin material whose asset name does NOT start with 'Buddy_Skin' (e.g. 'Patient_Skin_Closed'): OperationOpeningV02 stencils every slot whose material name starts with 'Buddy_Skin', so only the front zone is cut and the back, arms and head can never be culled.

2. Recommended shader fix as well: OperationMaskStencil_v02 'Cull Off' -> 'Cull Back' in its passes (ABDOMEN_MASK normals face out of the belly, checked in OperationAbdomen_v03_validation.json), so the mask writes no stencil when the opening is seen from inside/behind (patient turned over, camera below the table).

3. Anchors: INC_LIVER, INC_KIDNEY_L, INC_KIDNEY_R moved (organ centres, see organs.*.rest_socket); new INC_HEART, INC_LUNG_L, INC_LUNG_R, INC_CHEST, GUIDE_CHEST_START/END and SOCKET_* (organ frames). All bone-parented to mixamorig:Spine.

4. Organs: every ORGAN_* mesh is authored in its SOCKET frame at 1:1 world scale. In the body: a child of SOCKET_<organ> with localPosition 0, localRotation identity, localScale 1, using the mesh (MeshFilter.sharedMesh) - the same recipe OperationOpeningV02 uses for ABDOMEN_* under INC_ABDOMEN. On the tray / in hand use the same mesh at scale 1 (FBX/ORGAN_*_v03.fbx): sizes in organs.*.size_m_xyz_local, largest_dimension_m. Do not rescale organs any more (drop worldModelSize / organItemScale fitting for these meshes, or set them to the largest dimension).

5. Opening: OperationAbdomen_v03.fbx under INC_ABDOMEN (v03 marker moved to rest z 0.950). abdomenCutLength = guide_belly.length_m; abdomenHalfSize = (half_width, (half_length_top + half_length_bottom)/2) or use the asymmetric values; kidney cords from organs.ORGAN_KIDNEY_*.cords (same format as v02, marker-local Unity values).

6. Chest (future): RIBCAGE_v03.fbx and CHEST_VESSELS_v03.fbx under SOCKET_THORAX (identity). The sternum splits into STERNUM_L/R along GUIDE_CHEST_START->END; open by rotating RIBCAGE_HALF_L/R about local Y (see ribcage_notes). The heart's VESSELS_* are separate meshes; hide them at their snip points to free the heart.
